messages:
acme-integration: hey — after the canary swap this AM our webhook consumer started rejecting payloads. getting 400/401 and "Invalid JSON" from our endpoint. example payload attached.

acme-integration:
```
POST /webhook/customer/receive HTTP/1.1
Host: webhook.acme.example
Authorization: Bearer ****
Content-Type: application/json

{"order_id": "A123", "status": "ready", "meta": {"notes": "Delivered\nETA 3pm"},}
```

olivia (support): Thanks — sorry about the break. Are you using structured_output / json_mode? Which model tag are you pinned to? Can you paste the request_id from your failing request?

acme-integration: structured_output=true via "json" param. model: redwood/llama4b:v7.0-canary. Request id: req_0a7f2bf3

karen (oncall): seeing spike in 400s with same req_id in the edge logs. snippet:

```
[1715001234] req=req_0a7f2bf3 status=400 err=invalid_json client=webhook.acme.example route=/webhook/customer/receive
```

deploy-bot: Deployed redwood/llama4b:v7.0-canary -> canary @1715000000

cheng (eng-ml): suspicious — model seems to emit a trailing comma plus an invisible U+0000 in stream boundaries. can you fetch the raw stream chunks? also try setting "structured_output":{"mode":"json_strict"} as a temporary toggle.

acme-integration: fetched raw stream — here's last few chunks (tokens shown):

```
... "meta": {"notes": "Delivered\nETA 3pm"},\u0000
```

acme-integration: when we reassembled chunks the consumer JSON parser throws "Trailing comma" error. Some runs fine, others include the extra \u0000 char after comma.

cheng (eng-ml): likely tokenization boundary inserted a sentinel due to tokenizer update in v7 canary. reproducer:

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"model":"redwood/llama4b:v7.0-canary","structured_output":true,"prompt":"emit order json","stream":true}'

watch the chunks for `,` followed by `\u0000` or stray bytes.

olivia (support): short-term: set structured_output.mode=json_lenient or pin to stable model v6.3.2 — we'll add client-side sanitizer "strip_trailing_commas" to the webhook delivery pipeline. Engineering, can we push a fast rollback or sanitizer on canary routing?

cheng (eng-ml): I'll push a hotfix: streaming sanitizer that removes null bytes at chunk boundaries and collapses trailing commas in delivered payloads. Also recommend customers use "fallback_model":"redwood/llama4b:v6.3.2". Plan: hotfix to canary within 2 hours, patch to stable later.

acme-integration: thanks — we'll switch routing to fallback model and test. please keep us posted, this blocks order ingestion.
